reviews.notes: Initial pass FAIL: 3 blocking (chat entry booked a run nothing executed; the research.start chip escaped the kill switch and the tier gate; check-then-act race in ResearchService.start) plus 5 advisory. All 3 blocking fixed in 03af1521 and 830b099f; advisories A1 (bus never closed), A2 (spinner never retired) and A3 (client type drift) also fixed. Verified clean by the same reviewer: all 7 routes premium-gated with ownership checks, {path:path} cannot escape the namespace, permissions are first-match-wins so the deny rule is not shadowed. Open advisories: the serialization tests are Postgres-only so `make test` cannot fail on a lock regression, and a closed run keeps an empty tombstone channel for process life.

Initial pass FAIL: 1 blocking — decision E003 (chat entry) was cosmetic because nothing scheduled the runner; found independently of the correctness reviewer, from the opposite direction. Fixed in 03af1521. Confirmed PASS on both standing requirements: the harness is used rather than reimplemented (create_deep_agent, skills, memory, permissions, RubricMiddleware, TodoListMiddleware, CompositeBackend/StoreBackend, thread resume), and nothing existing was replaced (v13 byte-identical, v14 additive, the five specialists, tool registry and chat SSE parser untouched, no schema paths dropped). All seven recorded decisions implemented as decided.

Independent verification that the five findings were genuinely fixed rather than papered over, each failure scenario reconstructed. All five FIXED. Found NEW-1 (blocking, introduced by the A1 fix): a subscriber still inside its buffered replay hit the closed-flag early return and dropped the terminal event, so a completed run rendered as one that died; reproduced with a script. Fixed in 77367d10 and re-verified, along with NEW-2 (publish could resurrect a closed run). Then found NEW-4 (advisory, same symptom in a narrower window): the route read bus.has and then entered subscribe, and a run finishing in that gap ended the stream with no verdict; fixed in f6002074. Remaining advisories are the two carried above.
